### Changed (3 changes)

- **Breaking Change** [Upgrade RuboCop (to 1.66.0) and rubocop extensions](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/ruby/gems/gitlab-styles/-/commit/e72dc92b51f0ff2a6c0e923fc4bd23843701023f) by @schurzi ([merge request](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/ruby/gems/gitlab-styles/-/merge_requests/232))

- [Use grep twice to figure out bundler version](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/ruby/gems/gitlab-styles/-/commit/836e699bbe3484affdc4f31345195b263495f8d0) ([merge request](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/ruby/gems/gitlab-styles/-/merge_requests/224))
- [CI: Use same bundle version as mentioned in Gemfile.lock](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/ruby/gems/gitlab-styles/-/commit/f7fe8b4932d7f92070b0f437dd198f2c7873d98a) ([merge request](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/ruby/gems/gitlab-styles/-/merge_requests/222))

- [Remove Cop/WithoutReactiveCache](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/ruby/gems/gitlab-styles/-/commit/730b0b2a2e1899dfde30177f8bd699eaa610d110) by @schurzi ([merge request](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/ruby/gems/gitlab-styles/-/merge_requests/231))
